name: sivashanmuka-pos
description: Multi-shop point of sale for SIVASHANMUKA MULTI STORE and SIVASHANMUKA SMART SHOP. The repository keeps its existing React/TypeScript/Vite client and adds a modular Express API in TypeScript with PostgreSQL and Prisma.

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
